sources.title: Hybrid CNN-Transformer models for industrial defect detection: A ...
sources.snippet: The findings highlight the potential of hybrid CNN-Transformer models to improve defect detection accuracy while addressing the challenges of small, occluded, and irregular defects in complex industrial environments. However, further research is required to optimize model efficiency, generalization, and real-world deployment feasibility.
